technical.summary: Strong trend structure with bullish momentum and price above all key moving averages, but overbought oscillators across multiple timeframes and lack of fresh entry signals limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: LMT shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract wins, and no lobbying activity; earnings in 81 days present material risk with minimal fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (35 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; neutral composite signal.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (367.2) and recent FOMC event dominate; normal yield curve provides limited offset; 81-day earnings window presents moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong trend structure (ADX trending, price above EMA 200, supertrend bullish, OBV rising) with extreme market fear (VIX 367.2) creating contrarian buy opportunity at support zone.
debate.key_bear_argument: Multiple overbought oscillators (RSI 9/14, Stochastic, Williams %R) combined with no fresh entry signals, high earnings risk in 81 days, zero fundamental conviction, and unfavorable macro environment (FOMC crisis regime) make swing entry probability low despite technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Strong trend structure and extreme market fear create contrarian setup, but overbought oscillators across all timeframes eliminate fresh entry probability and signal exhaustion risk.
decision.primary_risk: Multiple overbought conditions (RSI 9/14, Stochastic, Williams %R) combined with 81-day earnings event risk and zero fundamental conviction in unfavorable macro regime create high probability of mean reversion into existing position.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical strength conflicts sharply with fundamental weakness, risk dominance, and overbought sentiment; debate winner (bear) reflects this tension.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding LMT with 22 other Industrials positions (17% sector concentration); adding to existing position during overbought conditions and high earnings risk violates concentration and sizing discipline.
